question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word in the given sentence.

The author\'s writing style is characterised by a __subtle__ and nuanced use of language.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"subtle"** means something that is delicate, elusive, or not obvious; it often involves fine or nuanced distinctions. (सूक्ष्म)

 
 
• **Example: **Her subtle hints went unnoticed by everyone.
 
 
 
• **"Sturdy" **refers to something that is strong, robust, or not easily affected. It is the antonym of subtle as it denotes something obvious and firm rather than delicate and nuanced. (मजबूत)
 
 
• **Example: **The sturdy structure of the bridge withstood the earthquake.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'subtle' **is **'sturdy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Elegant **(सुरुचिपूर्ण): Graceful and stylish in appearance or manner.

 
 
• **Example:** She wore an elegant dress to the gala.
 
 
 
• **Delicate **(नाजुक ): Easily broken or damaged; fragile.
 
 
• **Example: **The delicate glass vase shattered when it fell.
 
 
 
• **Elaborate** (विस्तृत): Involving many carefully arranged parts or details; detailed and complicated in design and planning.
 
 
• **Example:** The wedding decorations were elaborate and beautiful.
